profile.name: Muhammad Mudasir
profile.bio: Specializing in Web Development, Mobile Apps, and Automation Bots. Transforming ideas into high-performance digital reality.
profile.aboutText:
I am a passionate Full Stack Developer who believes that code is art. My journey started with a curiosity for how things work, which evolved into a career of building complex, high-performance systems.

Whether it's architecting a robust SaaS platform, optimizing an Automation bots, or crafting a pixel-perfect 3D website, I bring the same level of dedication and precision. I don't just write code; I engineer solutions that solve real-world problems.

experience.title: Freelance Full Stack Developer
experience.description: Delivered 20+ custom web applications and automation bots for international clients. Specialized in Next.js, React, and Python automation. Maintained a 5-star rating.

experience.title: Web Developer Intern
experience.description: Collaborated with senior developers to build responsive frontend interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Improved website load speed by 40%.

education.description: Specialized in Software Engineering, Web Technologies, and Database Management. Built multiple full-stack projects during the coursework.
Focused on Fundamentals of Programming, Computer Networks, and Database Systems. Secured excellent grades.
Completed secondary education with a major in Computer Science and Mathematics. Laid the foundation for a tech career.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce solution with real-time inventory, Stripe payments, and admin dashboard.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive e-commerce solution designed for scalability and performance. This platform features a real-time inventory management system, secure payment processing via Stripe, and a robust admin dashboard for analytics and order management. Built with Next.js 14 and Prisma, it ensures SEO optimization and lightning-fast page loads.
challenges: Handling concurrent checkout sessions without inventory conflicts.
Optimizing image loading for thousands of products.
Implementing complex tax calculation logic based on user location.

projects.title: SaaS Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time analytics platform for SaaS businesses featuring data visualization and user management.
projects.longDescription: A high-performance analytics dashboard tailored for SaaS businesses. It aggregates data from multiple sources to provide actionable insights through interactive charts and graphs. The system supports multi-tenancy, allowing different organizations to manage their data securely in isolation.
challenges: Visualizing large datasets without UI lag.
Ensuring data privacy in a multi-tenant architecture.
Managing WebSocket connections for real-time updates at scale.

projects.title: Corporate Portal
projects.description: Enterprise-grade portal with role-based access control and document management system.
projects.longDescription: An enterprise corporate portal designed to streamline internal communications and document management. It features a secure login system, departmental news feeds, and a centralized repository for company policies and documents. The system is built on Laravel for robust backend security.
challenges: Migrating legacy data to the new system.
Implementing complex permission hierarchies for different departments.
Ensuring GDPR compliance for employee data.

projects.title: Fitness Tracker Pro
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile app for tracking workouts and nutrition with social features.
projects.longDescription: A cross-platform mobile application that helps users track their fitness journey. It includes workout logging, nutrition tracking, and social features like challenges and leaderboards. Built with React Native, it offers a native-like experience on both iOS and Android.
features: Integration with Apple Health & Google Fit
challenges: Synchronizing offline data when connectivity is restored.
Optimizing battery usage for background step tracking.
Ensuring consistent UI across different device screen sizes.

projects.title: Food Delivery App
projects.description: On-demand food delivery application with live GPS tracking and payment integration.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive food delivery ecosystem connecting customers, restaurants, and riders. The app features live order tracking, secure payments, and a rating system. It uses Google Maps API for precise location services and route optimization.
challenges: Real-time location updates with low latency.
Handling peak load during lunch and dinner hours.
Complex algorithm for assigning riders to orders efficiently.

projects.title: Modern File Explorer
projects.description: A beautiful, highly customizable file explorer replacement for Windows with tabbed browsing.
projects.longDescription: A modern, aesthetic replacement for the default Windows File Explorer. It introduces tabbed browsing, dual-pane view, and extensive customization options. Built with Electron, it brings the power of web technologies to the desktop environment.
features: Dual-Pane View for Easy File Transfer
challenges: Optimizing file system operations for speed.
Handling large directories without UI freezing.
Ensuring compatibility with various Windows versions.

projects.title: POS System (Point of Sale)
projects.description: Offline-first retail management system for high-volume stores with inventory syncing.
projects.longDescription: A robust Point of Sale system designed for high-volume retail environments. It supports barcode scanning, receipt printing, and inventory management. The offline-first architecture ensures business continuity even during internet outages.
challenges: Ensuring data integrity during offline-online sync.
Interfacing with various hardware peripherals (scanners, printers).
Optimizing database queries for instant product lookup.

projects.title: LinkedIn Lead Scraper
projects.description: High-performance scraper to aggregate professional profiles and export to CSV/CRM.
projects.longDescription: An advanced automation tool for lead generation. It scrapes professional profiles based on specific criteria and exports the data to CSV or directly to a CRM. It includes anti-detection mechanisms to ensure reliable operation.
challenges: Bypassing complex CAPTCHAs and anti-bot measures.
Handling dynamic DOM changes on the target site.
Managing rate limits to avoid IP bans.
